Practised matching marks back to objects to check for missing or extra items; this was not steady yet.
Parth sometimes gave two marks to a large animal and changed the object count because of its size.

end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one marking and matching marks back to objects with Parth. Some examples used the method correctly, but Parth sometimes gave extra marks to a large animal or counted a spread-out row as having more objects; these mix-ups were still present at the end. At home, use small objects and have Parth touch each one once while making exactly one mark, then rearrange them and count again.
